data.title: 史黛菈 · 破军学园训练场的夕阳剑指
data.description: 黄昏时分空旷的破军学园演武场，金色晚霞将训练场地映得一片赤红。史黛菈身穿黑白修身的破军校服制服，手中名剑妃龙罪剑收于鞘内。微风吹散了她鬓角的火红发丝，制服领口在剧烈训练后微敞，薄汗在夕阳下闪闪发亮。转过身来，皇女拔剑指向你，红眸中闪烁着对对手的认可与少女不加掩饰的爱慕之火。
data.action: standing in academy training ground at sunset, hagun uniform slightly unbuttoned at neck, holding sheath of crimson broadsword, perspiration glistening, fiery passionate smile
data.location: open-air martial arts training ground during blazing orange sunset
data.lighting: fiery orange sunset rays casting long dramatic shadows across stone arena
data.mood: fierce martial romance, burning unyielding passion
data.promptProse: Standing in the academy training arena against a blazing sunset, Stella holds her broadsword sheath with unbuttoned uniform collar. Golden hour light catches her sweat-glistening collarbones as her red eyes burn with fierce, loving intensity.
data.animaCaption: Stella holding her sword in a sun-drenched training arena at sunset, her red eyes burning.
